issues.title: Cancelled customers still appear
issues.explanation: Filtering out cancel rows before ranking means a cancelled customer's last non-cancel change becomes rn = 1, so they are reported as active on their old plan.
issues.fix: Rank all rows, then filter l.action <> 'cancel' in the outer query together with rn = 1.

issues.title: RANK without id tie-break returns duplicates
issues.explanation: Rows with the same changed_at all get rank 1, so the customer comes out once per tied row, possibly with different plans. ANL-58 says the higher id wins.
issues.fix: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY changed_at DESC, id DESC).

issues.title: Window SUM keeps one row per payment
issues.explanation: SUM() OVER (PARTITION BY ...) does not collapse rows. paid has one row per payment, so the LEFT JOIN repeats each customer once per succeeded payment.
issues.fix: Use SUM(p.amount_cents) with GROUP BY p.customer_id.
